name: ESLint on Save
description: Runs eslint --fix on JavaScript and TypeScript files after Claude edits them
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Run eslint --fix on edited JS/TS files
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$ ]]; then
  if command -v npx &>/dev/null; then
    npx eslint --fix "$FILE" 2>/dev/null
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
      echo "ESLint found issues in $FILE"
    fi
  fi
fi
exit 0
